approved: The Crimes Legislation Amendment (Penalty Unit) Bill 2015 increases the Commonwealth penalty unit from $170 to $180, effective 31 July 2015, with indexation every three years based on the CPI starting 1 July 2018, to maintain the deterrent effect of financial penalties for all Commonwealth offences.

The speaker argued in favour of the Crimes Legislation Amendment (Penalty Unit) Bill 2015, which increases the Commonwealth penalty unit from $170 to $180 effective 31 July 2015 and introduces automatic indexation every three years according to the CPI, with the first adjustment on 1 July 2018. Labor supported the bill as a non-controversial measure to keep financial penalties in line with inflation and maintain their deterrent effect.

The bill increases the Commonwealth penalty unit from $170 to $180 and introduces automatic indexation every three years based on the consumer price index, starting in 2018, to keep penalties in line with inflation.
